flagged.evidence: The Definition covers finite-dimensional complex vector spaces without requiring inner products or bases, while [F1] cites def-qc-tensor-register-and-permutation for the generic claim that elementary tensors span each algebraic tensor product. That dependency defines ordered tensor registers using finite-dimensional complex inner-product spaces “each equipped with a specified ordered orthonormal basis”; it does not state the generic fact used in Proof 2.1. The published def-tensor-product-of-modules-by-generators-and-relations does state that every tensor is a finite sum of elementary tensors, but [F1] does not cite it.

Proof 1.1 asserts “The identity is self-adjoint.” The cited definition says a non-negative operator “is self-adjoint” and has nonnegative quadratic form, but does not establish I_H^*=I_H; the Facts provide no such derivation. The short calculation ⟨I_Hx,y⟩=⟨x,y⟩=⟨x,I_Hy⟩, with uniqueness of adjoints in finite dimensions, closes this proof-step gap.
